user.title: Set up Vistoda
user.description: Choose Blink's local Home Assistant adapter or a private EZVIZ/Ring bridge. Discovered remote bridges appear automatically; manual setup remains available.

data_description.provider: Blink reuses the loaded Home Assistant session. EZVIZ and Ring connect to separate private Rust bridges.

blink.title: Adopt the local Blink adapter
blink.description: Vistoda found Blink Live Bridge and will reuse its five existing live camera entities and authenticated Blink session. It will not create another login or duplicate cameras.

discovery_confirm.title: Connect discovered {provider} bridge
discovery_confirm.description: Vistoda discovered the private endpoint and device alias over mDNS. Confirm ownership with the dedicated bridge API token; vendor credentials are not requested here.

data_description.api_token: Dedicated high-entropy token configured in the discovered bridge. It is never broadcast over mDNS.

bridge.title: Connect Vistoda to the private bridge
bridge.description: These are bridge connection values, not vendor credentials. For EZVIZ, first enroll the account and device verification code in the EZVIZ Rust bridge. For Ring, the account and password are requested on the next screen.

data_description.url: Base HTTP or HTTPS URL reachable from Home Assistant, for example http://192.168.50.20:8787. Do not enter the Home Assistant, vendor-cloud or public Traefik URL.
data_description.api_token: Dedicated high-entropy token configured for this Rust bridge. Do not enter an EZVIZ verification code, Ring password or vendor token.
data_description.alias: Exact device alias configured in the bridge, for example entrance_door. Vistoda uses it to address the stream and snapshot.

ring_credentials.title: Enroll the Ring account
ring_credentials.description: Vistoda forwards these credentials once to your private Ring bridge over the configured connection. Home Assistant does not save them. Ring may then send an SMS code.

data_description.email: Email address used to sign in to the Ring app. Do not enter a Home Assistant user or bridge account.
data_description.password: Current password for that Ring account. It is sent once to the private bridge and is never persisted in the Home Assistant config entry.

otp.title: Verify the Ring SMS
otp.description: Enter the six-digit code from Ring within two minutes. The challenge is single-use: a wrong or expired code requires restarting enrollment.

data_description.code: Use only the newest SMS sent by Ring for this enrollment. This is not an EZVIZ device verification code or a bridge API token.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Vistoda
reconfigure.description: Update how Home Assistant reaches the private bridge. The vendor account session remains owned by the bridge and is not changed here.

data_description.url: New base URL reachable from Home Assistant, without credentials or an API path.
data_description.api_token: Dedicated API token currently configured by the private Rust bridge.
data_description.alias: Exact device alias currently configured in the bridge. Changing it may change which stream Vistoda requests.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the bridge. Check its private address, port, service status and firewall access from Home Assistant.
error.cannot_connect_restart: Verification could not complete. Check the bridge connection and start a fresh enrollment.
error.invalid_url: Enter a base HTTP or HTTPS bridge URL without credentials or API paths.
error.invalid_bridge_auth: The bridge API token is invalid. Use the dedicated token configured in the Rust bridge.
error.invalid_auth: Ring rejected the account email or password.
error.invalid_otp_restart: Ring rejected the code. Start a fresh enrollment; the old single-use challenge was consumed.
error.enrollment_busy: Another enrollment is active on this bridge.
error.enrollment_expired: The enrollment expired or was consumed. Start again.
error.rate_limited: The bridge or Ring is rate limiting enrollment. Wait before trying again.

abort.already_configured: This bridge device is already configured in Vistoda.
abort.blink_not_loaded: Blink Live Bridge must be loaded before Vistoda can adopt it.
abort.local_adapter: The local Blink adapter follows Blink Live Bridge and has no remote connection settings.
abort.unsupported_provider: The discovered service is not a supported Vistoda provider.
